                return (dt.year, dt.month, dt.day)
            if isinstance(dt, date):
                return (dt.year, dt.month, dt.day)
        except Exception:
            return None

    if isinstance(value, str):
        s = value.strip()
        if not s:
            return None

        # Try common date formats
        formats = [
            "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S",
            "%Y-%m-%d",
            "%d/%m/%Y",
            "%m/%d/%Y",
